svg.title: A message's layers
svg.desc: Garet's sister talking in Vale, her first page typed, as the player sees it, comes apart into the six sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. The map keeps its three layers: the grass and cliffs on BG3, trees and bushes on BG2, and a roof and a tree top on BG1, with Isaac, Garet, Garet's sister, a villager and a stone pillar as sprites level with BG2. The message window's frame and blue filling are tiles of BG0, the one layer every window shares. The words "You guys are so lucky, Garet.", her portrait and the page arrow are sprites at the front, riding on the window.
svg.text: A MESSAGE IN VALE, AS THE PLAYER SEES IT
